question: At fixed physical jump probability p and nonzero gradient field h, what exactly remains of the field in charge-conditioned logical sector ratios, and can the rough-boundary fugacity be bounded pointwise uniformly in L?

frozen_model.geometry: Canonical square_graph(L), L>=3, horizontal left-to-right and retained vertical bottom-to-top edges; left and right x=0,L-1 vertices are rough and unmeasured.
frozen_model.current: Independent j_e in {0,+1,-1}; w_h(0)=1-p and w_h(±1)=p exp(±h)/(2 cosh h), with 0<p<1 fixed.
frozen_model.observation: Integer signed Q_v=sum_in j-sum_out j at every interior detector; full rough charge vector is hidden.
frozen_model.sector: Binary occupancy parity across the canonical right logical cut, unchanged by current sign.
frozen_model.potential: psi(x,y)=x+y, so each stored edge has psi(head)-psi(tail)=1.

registered_branches.exact_reduction: Reparameterize the activity as p_eff=p/[p+(1-p)cosh h] and c=[p+(1-p)cosh h]/cosh h; derive sector sums as c^E exp[h M(Q)] times a zero-field p_eff rough-charge generating function.
registered_branches.pointwise_uniformity_test: Compare the admissible all-zero current and a single straight left-to-right row current, both with interior Q=0, to test whether rough fugacity ratios can be L-uniform. This is a configuration-level counterfamily, not a posterior-sector theorem.

verification: Exhaustively replay only existing square L=3 controls at p=.30, h=.10 and .50: direct product weights, gradient decomposition, activity reparameterization, and every charge-sector partition sum agree below 1e-12.
acceptance: State and prove the exact finite-volume identity; verify the registered L3 cells; establish or refute a size-independent pointwise bound on the rough fugacity, with explicit separation from averaged physical posterior claims.
claim_boundary: Neither activity reparameterization nor the configuration-level counterfamily determines fixed-h Bayes-risk scaling, a square phase, threshold, or uniform sector-posterior estimate.
stop_rule: Stop after exact proof and the two L3 replay cells; no new size, sample, crossing, fit or threshold.
outcome: The fixed-p field equals a zero-field p_eff channel tilted by a rough-charge fugacity, with a common measured-charge factor cancelling in sector ratios. A straight-row Q=0 family makes pointwise fugacity distortion exp[|h|(L-1)], so any fixed-h theorem needs an averaged sector-conditioned boundary estimate, not a uniform configurationwise gauge bound.
